rationale: The previous iteration reduced kd and ki to improve stability and reduce oscillations, and lowered base speed to 1.3 to prevent stalling. The oval track race was successful with no line loss and good completion, but the s-bend track caused off-track failure with one line loss event and increased steering oscillation (0.52 vs 0.41 previously). This suggests the robot struggles with sharper curves or more complex track sections. To address this, I will further reduce kd from 1.5 to 1.0 to dampen oscillations and improve smoothness. I will increase base speed slightly from 1.3 to 1.4 to regain some pace since the control is stable on the oval. I will also soften the sensor weights from [-1.5, -0.75, 0, 0.75, 1.5] to [-1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2] to reduce aggressive steering responses that may cause jitter and line loss on tight bends. The geometry remains unchanged as it was effective and well balanced. I continue to request the same comprehensive set of observations to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss events, steering oscillation, and control effort to evaluate the impact of these changes.
